title: CED-EF: Compressed Exact Diffusion with Error Feedback for Multi-Agent Learning
summary: We study decentralized stochastic optimization over a network of $N$ agents under compressed communication. We propose CED-EF, an exact diffusion-based method with error feedback that directly accommodates biased $δ$-contractive compressors while communicating one compressed model-sized vector per node per iteration. For smooth nonconvex objectives with unbiased stochastic gradients whose variance is bounded by $σ^2$, where $σ\geq0$, we establish a convergence rate whose leading stochastic term is $\mathcal O(σ/\sqrt{NK})$.
